• Identity: losa-data-sw AC Hu0/0/0/7.2034 (VLAN 2034) up in bg-client_losa-data-75fceaed-aa:bd-client_losa-data-75fceae (id 48, up), EVPN state up, EVI 9049 MPLS; gatech-data-sw AC Hu0/0/0/9.2033 (VLAN 2033) up in the same BG:BD (id 26, up), EVI 9049, RT import/export 398900:9049 both PEs (auto-derived, identical).
• Forwarding losa→gatech (BUM/unknown-unicast): losa has remote ingress-replication entry (PMSI Type 6) Originating IP/Nexthop 10.136.128.1, Label 24122, Source Remote, TEPid 0x02000007 — label matches gatech's advertised Multicast Label 24122; losa CEF 10.136.128.1/32 = labeled SR, imposed {402028} via Bundle-Ether101.3000 (nh 10.133.128.141); receiving AC Hu0/0/0/9.2033 up.
• Forwarding gatech→losa (BUM/unknown-unicast): gatech has remote entry (PMSI Type 6) Nexthop 10.137.0.1, Label 31687, Source Remote, TEPid 0x02000002 — matches losa's local multicast label 31687; gatech CEF 10.137.0.1/32 = labeled SR, imposed {402030} via Te0/0/0/20/0.3401 (nh 10.133.0.189); receiving AC Hu0/0/0/7.2034 up.
• Unknown-unicast flooding and BD MAC learning enabled on both BDs and ACs; 1 AC up, 0 PWs (normal for EVPN-native BD, not a fault).
• Unverified: no type-2/learned-unicast MAC installed in this BD on either PE (BD EVPN counters 0/0 both sides), so learned-unicast MAC distribution is not demonstrated; customer end-to-end L2 delivery was not tested.
• Note: the basic run's transport "unknown" for losa→gatech matched a CEF lookup of the PE's own loopback (receive adjacency); re-queried against the correct remote next hop it resolves labeled SR.
finding.cause: No fault found: PE-side forwarding readiness is established in both directions for the BUM/unknown-unicast class — matching ingress-replication entries (PMSI Type 6) with labels equal to each peer's advertised multicast label, resolved labeled-SR transport to each remote next hop, and both receiving ACs up in the correct BG:BD with EVI 9049 and compatible RTs. The basic check's single "unknown" (losa→gatech transport) was a misdirected lookup, not a transport failure. Learned-unicast MAC distribution is not proven (no type-2 entries in this BD on either PE); this is consistent with either no recent customer activity or aging, but neither was verified, and customer traffic delivery was not tested.
